summary: Eps 78-83 are six faithful canon rows covering the Vearn-Palace approach: the Zaboera/Crocodine reckoning and Hym's revival (78), the Hyunckel-Hym fist duel (79), Maximum and Larhart's return (80), Hyunckel's retirement and the Avan/Kill'vearn trap (81-82), and Baran's will passing to Dai (83). Delivered in the PRINTED space they run printed ch 271 -> 290 (vol 29-31), each boundary a straddle. CONTRACT FINDING, and the biggest thing in this file: the wave-14 task's stated conversion for dragonquest.fandom (its N >= 208 = printed N - 1) is NOT TRUE in this range - the fandom's episode fields and its chapter/volume pages are ALREADY in the printed 348 space here, so I applied NO conversion to fandom numbers and a -1 to en-WP / MangaDex / AniList / MU numbers. Proof (three independent checks, in structure.notes): the fandom's chapter pages 122 and 190-196 carry the printed titles at the printed numbers against the stored volume table; its own volume list gives vol 22 nine chapters (no extra 207) and vols 29/30/31 the printed ten-chapter blocks; and coco13.club's per-episode 原作 title ranges (which are unambiguous once converted through en-WP's volume list) match the fandom's raw numbers chapter-for-chapter from ep 54 to ep 96. The fandom DOES gain its one extra number, but late - between its 335 and 336 (vol 36), so only its ep 97-100 fields run one high. Consequence: the three stored wave-13 anchors that used the -1 from 208 (eps 57, 58, 59 - the wave-14 lower fence) are each one chapter low; repairs with old -> new are below, and sub-blocks a-g of this wave need the same correction if they applied the stated conversion.

Faithfulness clause (T28, Sean 2026-09-02): a set of short studio-made connective scenes inside adapted chapters - Crocodine thanking Garuda, Chiu collecting recovery items from everyone, Crocodine talking with Lon Berk while the surface party prepares, the Crocodine/Chiu/Beast-kun arrival at Vearn Palace, Chiu thanking the three flying monsters - plus Hym's transformation given red 魔炎気 and his two-page mob-clearing expanded into a full sequence. coco13 calls the anime-original share conspicuous, but it is connective padding inside adapted chapters, not a story-carrying original plot: canon stands.

Faithfulness clause: cuts only - Hyunckel crushing a stone (the moment he realises the fist is his last weapon) is dropped, and the manga's uneasy narration over his last charge is played straight. coco13: '79話は原作通り'.

Faithfulness clause: an added scene of Mystvearn explaining Maximum to Dai's party (with the Popp/Maam exchange about the Orichalcon King), Maximum given an added line about carrying combat records, and two of his/Hym's manga lines cut.

Faithfulness clause: Mystvearn's '自称最強' softened to 'ただの自惚れや', an added Avan line with the Mieru glasses, and Kill'vearn's swordplay - abbreviated in the manga - fully animated. coco13: '原作と大きな変更はなし'.

Faithfulness clause: added lines for Avan's old companions in the flashback; three manga lines cut (Avan's reason for only cracking Kill'vearn's mask, the Avan/Leona three-days joke, Mystvearn's 'せめてアバンかヒュンケルでもいれば').

Faithfulness clause: a newly animated Larhart childhood scene inside his account of Baran (absent from the manga), the allies who helped so far shown as Dai heads for the Tenma Tower, and Leona drawn wearing Feather. Short studio beats inside adapted chapters - canon stands.

flags_for_sean: CONTRACT / NUMBERING (the important one): the wave-14 premise 'dragonquest.fandom N >= 208 = printed N - 1' does not hold. The fandom is in the PRINTED space from ch 1 to ch 335 and gains its single extra number only at its 336 (vol 36), so only its ep 97-100 fields run one high. Evidence in structure.notes (its own chapter pages, its own volume list, and coco13's title ranges agreeing with its raw numbers at eps 55-62, 77-84 and 95-96). Sub-blocks a-g of this wave should be re-read against this before landing, and the three stored wave-13 anchors that used the -1 (eps 57, 58, 59) are repaired above.

The task premise is a claim, not a fact - recorded per the TBATE precedent. I re-derived the fandom's numbering from the live wiki rather than arguing from the stated conversion; had I applied it, every row in this file would have been one chapter low.

Split evidence on two ENDs (eps 80 and 83). dragonquest.fandom partitions ch 281 across eps 80/81 and ch 290 across eps 83/84 ('(partial)' on both sides - the same convention it uses for 271, 274 and 278, which coco13 confirms). coco13 instead ends ep 80 at 280 超戦士推参 and ep 83 at 289 予期せぬ難関, giving 281 and 290 wholly to the next episode. With no page count and no teaser wording, A47's unproven-tail convention advances, so I delivered 281 and 290 with a `partial`. A page check of the two episode endings would settle it; if they are scraps the ENDs are 280 and 289 and the continues stay as delivered.
